Notes from the field

01 / HOVER

A gentle approach

Guide the dragonfly with your pointer, a tap, or the Guide selector. It follows with a small, measured acceleration.

02 / DART

A brief departure

Invite a short flight. The body glides to a new position, steadies itself, then pauses before another dart.

03 / STILLNESS

Your own pace

Choose Slow or Still, or pause at any moment. Reduced-motion preferences show a static specimen with alternate poses.

Keyboard: Tab through the controls. On the focused specimen, arrow keys guide and Space pauses. Enter or Space activates buttons. Touch: tap to guide, then use the dart button. Scrolling stays available.
